title: Joshua's Inheritance
description: When the distribution of the land was finished, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them. At the Lord's command, he received the city he asked for: Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. There he rebuilt the city and settled in it. Thus Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the heads of families completed the distribution of the land by casting lots at Shiloh before the Lord.
